name: Armageddon Expo Tauranga
organizer: Beyond Reality Media Premier Event Management
blurb: The Tauranga stop of New Zealand's Armageddon Expo tour; no edition has run since March 2024 and it is no longer part of the tour's current line-up.
notes: The site's General Info nav currently lists only Auckland Spring, Auckland Autumn, Wellington, Christchurch and Palmerston North — no Tauranga page exists at /general-info/tauranga/ or similar — and the homepage's forward-looking ticker of 6 upcoming shows (through Aug 2027) does not include Tauranga either; the newer, smaller Palmerston North stop appears to have replaced it. Wikipedia's Armageddon Expo history table's most recent confirmed Tauranga date is 16-17 March 2024 at Baypark Arena, and none of the site's own 'Armageddon Updates' news posts found while researching this (covering the 2026-2027 touring season) mention Tauranga. Treated as inactive/dropped from the circuit rather than merely 'date not yet announced'; the given seed note describing it as 'currently-active' could not be confirmed.
